last_episode_to_air.name: Usagi's Love: The Moonlight Illuminates the Galaxy
last_episode_to_air.overview: As Galaxia closes in to take Sailor Moon's star seed, the Light of Hope finally reveals itself. Turning into a sword, the Light of Hope begs Usagi to use its power to stop Galaxia, who is now fully consumed by Chaos.

name: Sailor Moon
original_name: 美少女戦士セーラームーン
overview: One day, Usagi Tsukino, clumsy 2nd-year middle school student, stumbles upon a talking cat named Luna. Luna tells her that she is destined to be Sailor Moon, "champion of love and justice", and she must search for the fabled Moon Princess. Usagi finds friends that turn out to be destined senshi as well, and together they fight to save the world from the certain doom brought upon by the Dark Kingdom.

seasons.name: Sailor Moon
seasons.overview: Usagi Tsukino is a cheerful schoolgirl who often finds herself in unwanted trouble. One day, she saves a talking cat named Luna who gives Usagi a brooch that transforms her into Sailor Moon, guardian of love and justice!

seasons.name: R
seasons.overview: The Sailor Guardians are called back into action when powerful new enemies appear! The coming battle won't be easy, and it gets more complicated when a mysterious pinkhaired girl falls from the sky and goes after Mamoru!

seasons.name: S
seasons.overview: The Death Busters, lead by the maniacal Professor Tomoe, target innocent citizens in a search for three special pure heart crystals. Two powerful new Sailor Guardians are already seeking the crystals and have no interest in working with Sailor Moon and the other Guardians. Where did they come from, and what is their plan for the talismans?

seasons.name: SuperS
seasons.overview: A majestic, golden-horned pegasus has appeared in Chibi-Usa's dreams, requesting her aid! His plea turns out to be more than a dream when the fearsome Dead Moon Circus arrives in Tokyo—hunting Pegasus! Sailor Moon and the Guardians must fight, but without the Holy Grail, what is Sailor Moon to do? Pegasus has a solution and his power will change Sailor Moon forever!

seasons.name: Sailor Stars
seasons.overview: Sailor Moon and the Sailor Guardians are about to face their greatest challenge yet—high school! But as the girls take their next big step in life, a mysterious force frees the evil Queen Nehalennia! Who could be behind this new wave of evil? And why are the Sailor Star Lights so resistant to working with Sailor Moon?

tagline: In the name of the Moon, I'll punish you!
